rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 40, EIC Step 1, question 2: "Do you, and your spouse if filing a joint return, have a social security number ... that allows you to work and is valid for EIC purposes". The project line is unchanged by the household pass (BUG-0272 to BUG-0275 reword the questions household.unmarried, household.qss_eligible and household.home_cost and the household.qss_fails remedy at f1040.line12e; no household expression changed). The line is the filers' test. The reply requires that no person and no dependent entry answers dependent.eic_ssn no. rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 17, Before you begin: "If you want to claim the credit for other dependents, you, and your spouse if filing jointly, must have either an SSN or ITIN issued on or before the due date of your 2025 return (including extensions)"; p. 19, Step 5, question 1. The project line is unchanged by T-091 (BUG-0264 to BUG-0266 reword only the household.qss_eligible question; the new dependent gate dependent.hoh_absence reaches household only through dependent.hoh_test2 in household.test2_persons). The line is the filers' test; the reply has it and adds that every dependent entry has dependent.tin, a test the source applies to each child separately (i1040gi p. 18, Step 3, question 1). On a return that lists a person without a TIN it would deny the filer-level test for every other dependent. executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/household.deepseek.json`; 1,408 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 211 partial records; 2,119 comparisons): 2,040 of 2,119 agree; 79 value; on returns the full interview completes: none. No completed-return difference: a listed person without a TIN is refused elsewhere (dependent claimed_no_tin) or the return is incomplete. Off completed returns: 79 value, project yes and candidate no: 76 refused returns (for example classm.dependent.7.deepseek, classm.f8962.6.deepseek, classm.eic.8.deepseek) and 3 incomplete (audit.dependent.listed_not_dependent_no_tin and two partial records of classm.dependent.7.deepseek). As ruled for its fix-round-2 reply ("Adds every dependent entry's TIN"). Project stands.

The other spouse must have either an SSN or ITIN, and it must have been issued on or before the due date of the return (including extensions)". The project line is unchanged by T-091 (BUG-0264 to BUG-0266 reword only the household.qss_eligible question; the new dependent gate dependent.hoh_absence reaches household only through dependent.hoh_test2 in household.test2_persons). The line is the filers' identification test. The reply requires household.taxpayer_work_ssn (yours only, not your spouse's) and that every dependent.ctc_child has a work SSN; dependent.ctc_child itself reads household.ctc_ssn, so the reply's line is a cycle and evaluates to unknown wherever a dependent entry exists. It also drops the other spouse's SSN-or-ITIN test. executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/household.deepseek.json`; 1,408 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 211 partial records; 2,119 comparisons): 1,650 of 2,119 agree; 393 candidate-unknown, 76 candidate-refuses; on returns the full interview completes: 103 candidate-unknown. Off completed returns: 290 candidate-unknown of the same cycle (including t091.absence.hoh_refused and t091.absence.other_tests_unchanged) and 76 candidate-refuses, dependent refusals reached through dependent.ctc_child. As ruled for its fix-round-2 reply ("Cycle through dependent.ctc_child"). Project stands.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 14, Head of Household: "Check the 'Head of household' box only if you are unmarried (or considered unmarried) and either Test 1 or Test 2 applies"; Test 1: "Your parent didn't have to live with you" (the cost is of the parent's home). The project line is unchanged by T-091 (BUG-0264 to BUG-0266 reword only the household.qss_eligible question; the new dependent gate dependent.hoh_absence reaches household only through dependent.hoh_test2 in household.test2_persons). The reply never reads f1040.status, so it fails every return not filed as head of household whose filer does not meet the tests, and it requires household.home_cost (your own home) for Test 1. It reaches dependent.hoh_test2 and so carries the T-091 gate as the project does. executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/household.deepseek.json`; 1,408 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 211 partial records; 2,119 comparisons): 530 of 2,119 agree; 1,460 value, 63 candidate-refuses, 62 candidate-unknown, 3 project-refuses, 1 project-unknown; on returns the full interview completes: 237 value, 14 candidate-unknown. Every completed-return difference was enumerated with the witness cap lifted (triage.mjs run directly; scratch /private/var/folders/kw/rp67pf8d5ng588lqp7d_gb240000gn/T/opencode/adj-t091-household/household.deepseek.full.json; the uncapped rerun reproduces the recorded counts exactly): 237 value, project no and candidate yes: 236 returns not filed as head of household (156 single, 48 joint, 32 qualifying surviving spouse; for example classm.s3.2.deepseek) and 1 head of household return that qualifies under Test 1 with home_cost no (generated 381); 14 candidate-unknown, answers the project asks only on a head of household return: 7 partial records withholding household.home_cost, 3 withholding household.unmarried, and 4 dependent.born_died (classm.f8962.5 and .deepseek, generated 22 and 361). Off completed returns: 1,223 value of the same kinds (including t091.absence.test1_not_reached, the Test 1 parent with home_cost no); 63 candidate-refuses, dependent refusals reached on returns not filed as head of household (including dependent[child].hoh_absence on t091.absence.other_tests_unchanged, filed single); 48 candidate-unknown; 3 project-refuses (audit.household.hoh_community_property, the dropped community property refusal; audit.dependent.hoh_test1_no_tin and generated 357, dependent refusals the reply's short-circuit skips); 1 project-unknown (partial record of classm.dependent.7.deepseek withholding household.community_property). As ruled in fix round 5. Project stands.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 14, Head of Household: "Check the 'Head of household' box only if you are unmarried (or considered unmarried) and either Test 1 or Test 2 applies", where Test 1 is a home kept up for your parent and only Test 2 is "a home in which you lived". The candidate never reads f1040.status, so it reports a failure on every return that is not head of household, and it requires household.home_cost (your own home) for Test 1 as well. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/household.deepseek.json): 425 of 1,783 agree; 1,216 value differences, project False against candidate True, are mostly returns not filed as head of household (classm.f2441.2.deepseek: status mfj, home_cost false); 46 candidate-unknown records lack household.unmarried on non-HOH returns (classm.f8889.3.deepseek, stage16.cleanup.refuse.f1040_line16); 93 candidate-refuses are dependent refusals reached on non-HOH returns (classm.asset.1, classm.sc.1); the 3 project-refuses are cited project gates (audit.dependent.hoh_test1_no_tin: claimed_no_tin; generated 357: married dependent; audit.household.hoh_community_property: amb.2025.hoh_community_property). The project's own death-year defect in the Test 1/Test 2 inputs is ruled as a finding in the Claude log.

The reply tests at least two people with a Form 8889, as the project tests exactly two (household.roster_bad admits at most two person entries), and adds household.married yes.
